The summary agent reads only what build_data.py put on the card: accepted claims, field states,
the sides of each disagreement and the code lines. It writes one sentence at a time and cites what
each sentence rests on. Code checks every sentence before it is kept:

sentences.text: The reports place the Iron Lake Project in the Clinton Mining Division of south central British Columbia, 45 kilometers northeast of 100 Mile House, and describe it as a copper, gold, platinum group elements and nickel project.

It is centred on the Iron Lake Complex, a mafic to ultramafic intrusion of early Jurassic age in the Quesnel terrane that intrudes Nicola Group rocks and is in contact with the Takomkane Batholith; the complex is more than 13 km long and up to 6 km wide.

The reports describe disseminated sulfide with copper, gold, platinum and palladium, and massive sulfide with copper, nickel and cobalt, and say the 2005-6 drilling intersected semi-massive to massive sulphides in ultramafic rocks of the complex.

Recent surveys include a 2019 IP and magnetometer survey over the Central Zone, a 2021 airborne MMT-EM and magnetic survey by Tech-X, a 2022 IP survey of 48.3 line-km on three grids, and a 2023 helicopter-borne Xcite time domain EM survey.
Diamond drilling in 2022 totalled 5,001.30 m, which matches the 23 holes in the collar table on 41327 p30.
Significant 2022 intervals listed on 41327 p33 include 13.16 m of 0.18% Cu and 23 ppb Pt in IL-22-006 from 123.82 m, and 2.15 m of 0.48% Cu and 86 ppb Au in IL-22-013 from 116.32 m.
For 2023 drilling, 41800 p33 and 41800 p38 give 1,680 m while 41800 p9 gives 1,670 m; the reports disagree, and the collar table on 41800 p33 backs 1,680 m from 3 holes of 606, 750 and 324 m.
In 2023, IL-23-024 returned 9.46 m of 0.42% Cu from 569.00 m, including 0.50 m of 1.17% Cu, and IL-23-26 returned 0.47 m of 0.65% Cu and 295 ppb Pd from 216.04 m (41800 p37).

The sources disagree on location: coordinates on 36807 p1 sit 62.0 km from those in the other reports, such as Latitude 51° 57' N, Longitude 120° 54' W on 34595 p3, and all 26 drill collars back the other reports' position.
They also disagree on map sheet, where 34595 p1 gives 093N034 and the other reports give 092P; the drill collars all fall in 092P.

Within the reports, IL-22-011 is given as 2.07 m on 41327 p33 and 2.36 m on 41327 p34, and the lab assays back 2.07 m; IL-23-25 from 318.25 m is given as 0.002% Cu on 41800 p37 and 6 ppm Cu on 41800 p10, and the lab assays back 6 ppm.

No resource estimate is stated for Iron Lake itself, the 2023 report warns that its aqua regia assays may be lower than actual values, 41327 p32 says two batches failed the QA/QC procedures, and the IL-22-20 entry of 2.50 m with 0.02% Cu does not match the lab sample from 209.50 to 211.00 m, which is 1.50 m with Cu 0.326%.
